main.role: the newest pre-rewrite main commit that history holds; latest_install is the derivation at it. The thirteen commits after it up to the rewrite (2ed8f4214..a94664026 here) change no provider or shared TeX source.

finding: Where at_backfill and latest_install differ, the backfill recorded the earlier value, which is stale at main. On 2026-09-23 the maintainer authorized correcting those eleven records to latest_install, and they now record it.
